guide.title: Ticket Setup Guide
guide.intro: Work through the sections below. The last one takes your system live.
guide.advertText: **New here?** The Setup Guide walks you through configuring this system.

sectionDesc.general: Pick how tickets open and give this system a name.
sectionDesc.staff: Who handles tickets. Staff can claim, reply, and close.
sectionDesc.dm: Relay each ticket into its creator's DMs; staff reply with a prefix.
sectionDesc.notifications: Ping your team the moment a ticket opens.
sectionDesc.reminders: Nudge staff about unclaimed or stale tickets.
sectionDesc.inactivity: Warn ticket creators and auto-close tickets that go quiet.
sectionDesc.limits: Cap open tickets and control who can open or take them.
sectionDesc.botIdentity: Run this system under your own bot.
sectionDesc.goLive: Flip the switch and give members a way to open tickets.

goLive.label: Go Live
goLive.enableDesc: Activate this ticket system. A panel can only be posted while it is active.
goLive.panelDesc: The panel is the message members press to open a ticket. Build one, pick this system as one of its kinds, and post it to a channel.

gates.customBot: Do you want to run this on your own bot?
gates.notifications: Do you want your team pinged when a ticket opens?
gates.reminders: Do you want staff and users reminded about waiting tickets?
gates.autoClose: Do you want inactive tickets to close on their own?
gates.limits: Do you want to limit who can open tickets, or how many?

pickChannel: Pick a Channel to send the "Start Ticket" Message in
initDesc: Click the Button below to create a Ticket
editSteps:
1. Copy the Message URL of the "Start Ticket" Message
2. Enter the `/embed-builder create` Command and press `Start Over`
3. Create your desired Embed
4. Once done, press the `Edit` Button and paste the Message Link into the shown Text field

alreadyInTicket:

settings.overviewDescription: Each ticket system is its own setup - channels, staff, panels, and rules. Pick one to edit, or create another for a different kind of ticket.

settings.inviteBotNoToken: No custom bot is set for this system yet. Add a bot token first.

descriptions.panelEditor: Create, edit, and post the "Start Ticket" panels for this server
descriptions.tierEditor: Add and order the escalation tiers a ticket can be escalated to
descriptions.name: A short label for this system, shown in lists and summaries
descriptions.type: Type of configuration to apply to tickets
descriptions.logMode: Whether logs are posted to a channel or grouped into a thread
descriptions.allowCreatorClose: Let the ticket creator close their own ticket
descriptions.category: The category ticket-channels will be created under
descriptions.channel: The channel ticket-threads will be created in
descriptions.archiveCategory: The category closed ticket-channels are moved to
descriptions.archiveDuration: How long a ticket thread can stay inactive before Discord auto-archives it.
descriptions.logChannels: Channels that receive ticket log messages
descriptions.staffThreads: Open a private staff-only discussion thread per ticket
descriptions.staffThreadsChannel: The channel staff discussion threads are created in
descriptions.mentionRoles: Roles pinged when a ticket is opened
descriptions.mentionUsers: Users pinged when a ticket is opened
descriptions.sendMessagePrefixes: Staff put one of these at the start of a message to send their reply to the ticket creator.
descriptions.dmEnabled: Let users open this kind by sending the bot a direct message (DM).
descriptions.dmInstantOpen: Open a ticket immediately when a user DMs the bot identity, skipping the greeting and button. Requires DM intake and a bot identity.
descriptions.panelButtonLabel: The text on the panel's button (the default is "Start Ticket").
descriptions.createTags: Forum tags applied when a ticket is created
descriptions.claimTags: Forum tags applied when a ticket is claimed
descriptions.closeTags: Forum tags applied when a ticket is closed
descriptions.tagClaimer: Rename the ticket post to show the staff member who claimed it.
descriptions.remindUnclaimedAfter: Ping the claim tier this long after a ticket is opened and not claimed. Use 0 to turn this off.
descriptions.remindUnclaimedEvery: Send the unclaimed reminder again after this much time. Use 0 to send it only once.
descriptions.remindStaleAfter: Ping the staff member who claimed the ticket this long after the last reply. Use 0 to turn this off.
descriptions.remindStaleEvery: Send this reminder again after this much time. Use 0 to send it only once.
descriptions.inactivityWarnAfter: Warn the ticket creator after this long with no reply. Use 0 to turn this off.
descriptions.inactivityCloseAfter: Close the ticket on its own this long after the warning. Use 0 to turn this off.
descriptions.remindRoles: Roles pinged by the unclaimed reminder. If empty, the mention roles are used, then staff roles.
descriptions.remindUsers: Users pinged by the unclaimed reminder. If empty, the mention users are used, then staff users.
descriptions.botToken: Run this ticket system under a different bot. The token is stored safely and never shown again.
descriptions.inviteBot: Generate an invite link for the configured custom bot
descriptions.clearToken: Remove the custom bot so this system falls back to the main bot
descriptions.presenceType: What the custom bot's status shows - Playing, Listening to, Watching, Competing in, or a free-form Custom status.
descriptions.presenceText: The status text. For Custom it is the status itself; otherwise it follows the verb, e.g. "Listening to <text>".
descriptions.presenceEmoji: Emoji shown before a Custom status. Use a standard emoji or a custom one in <:name:id> form.
descriptions.placementMode: Escalated tickets go to a separate space per tier, or one shared forum where the tier is a tag.
descriptions.forumChannel: The forum or media channel that holds every ticket when you use the unified-forum option.
descriptions.allowTakeClaim: Let a higher-tier staff member take a ticket that another staff member has already claimed.
descriptions.staffTierRoles: Staff priority tiers, lowest to highest. A member's tier is the highest of these roles they have.
descriptions.ticketLimitTotal: The most open tickets one user can have on this whole server at the same time. Use 0 for no limit.
descriptions.ticketLimitKind: The most open tickets one user can have from this kind at the same time. Use 0 for no limit.

reasons.customBotOnly: Set a custom bot token first

optionDescriptions.channel: Each ticket gets its own text channel under a category
optionDescriptions.thread: Each ticket is a private thread in one fixed channel
optionDescriptions.dmToChannel: Members write to the bot in DMs, staff answer from a per-ticket channel
optionDescriptions.dmToThread: Members write to the bot in DMs, staff answer from a private thread

options.unifiedForum: Unified forum (tier is a forum tag)

logs.logExplain: Start your message with a reply prefix to send it to the ticket creator. Messages with no prefix stay staff-only.
logs.logExplainAll: All messages here are sent to the ticket creator. Add reply prefixes in settings to change this.
